text:
elaine: FYI — seeing p95 +40-60ms on /console/v1/permissions after the rbac-editor rollout. Traces point to permissions service auth_check sync call.
sam: when did this start? numbers pls
elaine: started ~1714980000 (post-deploy). Quick stats: p50 +5ms, p95 +45ms, ~10% of requests hit >120ms. error rate flat. cache hit ~62% for per-route scope set.
priya: that's rough. is the check doing a DB join per request? code path?
elaine: yes — inserver: permissions.getScopes(tenant, route) does a SQL join + serialize. stack: console -> permissions-api sync -> postgres.
vic: can we move to signed scope blob on token? e.g., at auth time issue X-Scopes-JWT and console verifies locally. tradeoffs: token size, revocation/rollout complexity.
olivia: also need to consider quota calculation. quota-token currently reuses same sync path; if we cache scopes locally we'd have to ensure quota still accurate.
priya: alternative: introduce an in-memory route->allowedRoles cache in console with TTL 30s and a background reconciler. cheaper than changing token flow.
elaine: TTL 30s looks promising — reduces syncs and keeps freshness. but need telemetry: measure auth_check latency and cache hit tag. add metric: console.permissions.auth_check.ms and console.permissions.cache_hit{true|false}.
sam: agree — minimal blast radius. rollout plan: feature-flag rbac_optimize_cache, start 10% tenants canary → 50% → 100%. need alert if p95 increases by >10ms or error rate >0.5%.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: rbac_optimize_cache=on for tenants a1,a2,a3,a4 (6 instances). monitor window 30m.
vic: one more thought — for enterprise tenants that require strict immediate revocation, bypass cache (per-tenant override). add config: tenant.policy.cache_bypass=true.
elaine: yep. action items: priya + vic to sketch impl (reconciler + metrics) by EOD, sam to add rollout + alerts, olivia to check quota edgecases. I'll open a short PR with proto of metric names.
priya: ok starting a doc, will paste proto in thread.
priya: proto snippet:
```yaml
console:
  permissions:
    cache_ttl_seconds: 30
    reconciler_interval_seconds: 10
    metrics:
      auth_latency_metric: "console.permissions.auth_check.ms"
      cache_hit_metric: "console.permissions.cache_hit"
    per_tenant_overrides:
      enable_cache: true
```
elaine: thanks — once priya/vic have PR I'll kick off canary and sign-off. :thumbsup:
